def run_oof_multi_seed(features_df, y_int, seeds=(42, 43, 44), n_splits=5, epochs=18, bag=1):

        )
        blend = 0.5 * oof_deep + 0.5 * oof_tree

        acc_d = float(((oof_deep >= 0.5).astype(int) == y_int).mean())
        acc_t = float(((oof_tree >= 0.5).astype(int) == y_int).mean())
        print(
            f"[multi-seed] seed={seed} deep={acc_d:.5f} tree={acc_t:.5f} blend={acc:.5f}"
        )
        results.append((oof_deep, oof_tree, acc))
    return results
